title: Write 20 · 九 妹 贵 页 弟 百 奶 牛 爷 鸡 蛋 零 渴 米 客
focus: 九 妹 贵 页 弟 百 奶 牛 爷 鸡 蛋 零 渴 米 客
body:
Family members, food and the last numbers: 爷爷, 奶奶, 妹妹, 弟弟, 鸡蛋, 牛奶, 米, 九, 百, 零.

## Repeating parts
- **女 woman**: on the left of 妹 and 奶.
- **贝 shell (money)**: under 贵. **页** is related; 页 means "head/page".
- **雨 rain**: flattened on top of 零.
- **宀 roof**: on top of 客.

## Rules that matter here
- **Left-falling before the fold:** 九 is 丿 first, then 乙.
- **Centre first:** in 米, the two dots go first, then 一, then the middle 丨, then 丿 and ㇏.

cards.Notes: 2 strokes: 丿 FIRST, then 乙 (the fold-hook). Lookalike 力 lì (the hook stroke comes first there).
女 woman + 未 wèi (phonetic). 8 strokes. 女, then 未 (一, 一, 丨, 丿, 丶). Trap: in 未 the top 一 is SHORTER. In 末 mò the top 一 is longer.

cards.Prompt: 太＿了 · tài guì le · too expensive
cards.Notes: A 中-like top plus a long 一, over 贝 shell (money). 9 strokes. 丨, 𠃍, 一, 丨, the long 一, then 贝 (丨, 𠃌, 丿, 丶).

cards.Prompt: 第一＿ · dì-yī yè · page one
cards.Notes: 一 over 贝-like body. 6 strokes: 一, 丿, 丨, 𠃍, 丿, 丶. It is the radical in 题, 顾, 预. Not 贝 (4 strokes).
丷 + 弓-like body + 丨 + 丿. 7 strokes: 丶, 丿, ㇕, 一, ㇉, then the long 丨, and the 丿 LAST.
一 over 白 bái (phonetic). 6 strokes. 一, then 白 (丿, 丨, 𠃍, 一, 一). Lookalike 白 lacks the top 一.
女 woman + 乃 nǎi (phonetic). 5 strokes. 女 (㇛, 丿, ㇀), then 乃: the ㇌ fold-hook FIRST, then 丿.
An ox head. 4 strokes: 丿, 一, 一, then the 丨 down through both. Lookalike 午 wǔ (noon): its 丨 doesn't poke out the top.
父 father + 卩. 6 strokes. 父 (丿, 丶, 丿, ㇏) on top, then 卩 (㇆, 丨).
又 + 鸟 bird. 7 strokes. 又 (㇇, ㇏), then 鸟 (丿, 𠃌, 丶, ㇉, then the bottom 一). Lookalike 鸟 niǎo vs 乌 wū (乌 has no dot).
Top part over 虫 insect. 11 strokes. The top part (5 strokes) ends with a long ㇏ sweeping right. Then 虫 (口, 丨, 一, ㇀, 丶).
雨 rain + 令 lìng (phonetic). 13 strokes. Flattened 雨 (8), then 令 (人, 丶, ㇇, 丶). Compare 冷 (冫 + 令).
氵 water + 曷 hé (phonetic): wanting water. 12 strokes. 氵, then 曷 (日, 勹, 人, then 乚). Lookalike 喝 hē (to drink) has 口.
Grains of rice. 6 strokes: 丶, 丿 (top dots), 一, 丨, then 丿, ㇏. Lookalike 来 lái.
宀 roof + 各 gè (phonetic). 9 strokes. 宀 (丶, 丶, 乛), then 各 (夂 over 口). Mirror pair: 客观 objective vs 主观 subjective.
